scope: Two missing New Haven grand-jury resisters, each with two separate verified custody intervals and a month-precision birth date.

first-court.label: In re Grusse, 402 F. Supp.1232: February19,1975 civil-contempt adjudication; remand initially stayed.

second-court.label: In re Turgeon, 402 F. Supp.1239: memorandum dated June6,1975; remand stayed to June10. Website June25 heading is not the custody start.

contemporary.label: Le Quotidien des femmes,1975 no.4: March5 confinement and April1 release.

bard.label: Bard Observer,March26,1975,p.9,Liberation News Service report: continued confinement after March5.

births.label: Richard Harris, Taking the Fifth-I,April5,1976: Grusse born June1946; Turgeon born June1943; feminist organizing.

release.label: Richard Harris, Taking the Fifth-III,April19,1976: actual June10 surrender and December19 departure from Niantic.

prisoner.name: Ellen Grusse
prisoner.description: Ellen Grusse was a New Haven feminist imprisoned for refusing federal grand-jury testimony in 1975. Two civil-contempt proceedings resulted in separate periods of confinement.

cases.charges: Civil contempt for refusing grand-jury testimony — 28 U.S.C. §1826
cases.sentence: February 19 contempt order; execution stayed. Actual confinement March 5 to April 1, 1975. This was coercive civil custody, not a criminal conviction.

cases.charges: Second civil contempt for refusing grand-jury testimony — 28 U.S.C. §1826
cases.sentence: June 6 contempt order; remand stayed to June 10. Imprisoned at Niantic until December 19, 1975 after subpoenas were withdrawn.

case_research.custody_evidence: Contemporary reports establish March custody and subsequent release; the earlier adjudication date is not the jail-entry date.
Court order and contemporaneous account distinguish actual confinement from the stay and anticipated grand-jury expiration.

entries.custody_evidence: Contemporary reports establish March custody and subsequent release; the earlier adjudication date is not the jail-entry date. Court order and contemporaneous account distinguish actual confinement from the stay and anticipated grand-jury expiration.
entries.status_research: Historical custody verified. Existing profiles, cases and photos are preserved. No unsupported vital dates, coordinates, current incarceration, institutional relation or personal support website inferred. Birth precision is month, with no known day. Death date and portrait are unverified. These New Haven resisters were related to the Lexington Six investigation, but were not members of that six-person group. No bank-robbery conviction is asserted. The gap between custody episodes remains excluded. Current living/deceased status is unresolved.
